name: weather-package
description: Daymet modelled daily weather at the returned point 35.9313, -84.3104, requested 2024-12-26 through 2024-12-31. Daymet's year is always 365 days. 29 February is present and 31 December is dropped in leap years, so an annual total from a leap year is a 365-day total and the missing date is named on any answer whose range covers it.
citation: Thornton; M.M.; R. Shrestha; Y. Wei; P.E. Thornton; S-C. Kao; and B.E. Wilson. 2022. Daymet: Daily Surface Weather Data on a 1-km Grid for North America; Version 4 R1. ORNL DAAC; Oak Ridge; Tennessee; USA. https://doi.org/10.3334/ORNLDAAC/2129
citeAs: Thornton; M.M.; R. Shrestha; Y. Wei; P.E. Thornton; S-C. Kao; and B.E. Wilson. 2022. Daymet: Daily Surface Weather Data on a 1-km Grid for North America; Version 4 R1. ORNL DAAC; Oak Ridge; Tennessee; USA. https://doi.org/10.3334/ORNLDAAC/2129
